selection.population: public-v2 validation230 already exposed to retrieval selection
selection.exclude: every validation component containing any consumed32 ID
selection.graph: all annotated candidate IDs, normalized/0.90 Jaccard claim and evidence variants; official labels/positive IDs excluded from graph selection
selection.order: domain-separated SHA of sorted component IDs, then first SHA-ranked claim within each component

initial_information.retrieve: original immutable claim BM25 Top20 of identical 5240-document corpus
initial_information.full_context: first five candidates complete sentences, retained once shown
initial_information.previews: remaining capacity only; same payload packed against maximum initial gate/plan prompt size

tools_shared: same typed executor, RRF k60 query fusion, full Top20 rerank, actual complete sentence delivery, empty/error fields
fixed: one model upfront plan using initial frame, up to five initial reads then up to two queries then rerank; no feedback replanning
deterministic: up to five unread initial sources then existing deterministic two-query transformation then rerank
autonomous: optional read/query/rerank or stop gate; stop legal regardless of evidence; separate common verifier
terminal: identical system/schema: SUPPORTS/REFUTES with at most three unique displayed sentence citations, or insufficient/conflicting evidence abstention; no terminal tools
cost: all physical plan/gate/repair/verdict attempts, input/output tokens, tool counts/latency, rerank requested/completed pairs/tokens/swaps, loader/preparation/scoring/operator wall clock; unknown attempts not free; no rerank on empty pool

scoring.official_task: SUPPORTS/REFUTES exact label; NEI only intentional insufficient-evidence abstention; DISPUTED only intentional conflicting-evidence abstention; errors/exhaustion never correct abstentions
scoring.all_task_denominator: all frozen tasks per arm; no dropped empty/error/budget cases; incomplete matrix unscored
scoring.citation_proxy: every cited source in official decisive evidence-ID set; NOT semantic support of the specific verdict
scoring.joint_proxy: task correct AND nonempty official-ID-concordant citations, all-task denominator; abstentions score zero here and separately count task correctness
scoring.true_semantic_support_and_joint: unmeasured; no human blind labels, author assessment or automated entailment judge
scoring.retrieval_secondary: Recall@5, MRR@10, nDCG@10 and Top5 Evidence F1 over final ranked Top20 candidates (legacy delivered_evidence_ids includes preview-only/not-read sources), NOT complete-text delivery; official evidence-bearing tasks incl errors/empty outcomes; separate denominator from all-task correctness; 5000 paired bootstrap, NOT citation/entailment F1
scoring.behavior: proposal, validation, execution, full-text delivery, later physical prompt, later validated decision, final citations separately; opportunity/use proxy NOT causal effect
